title: Work IQ: invoke custom agents and agents that call third-party tools
summary: Hold: the agent-block control overstates its reach by describing whether a custom agent can be used anywhere in the tenant. Microsoft documents different blocking effects by authoring platform, including a Microsoft Copilot Chat-only restriction for SharePoint and Foundry agents. The roadmap details, consumption licensing and remaining controls are supported.
